adtcore:objectReference.adtcore:name: Add implementation for 'run'
adtcore:objectReference.adtcore:description: Creates an empty method implementation for method run in class lcl.

adtcore:objectReference.adtcore:name: Generate factory method 'create'
adtcore:objectReference.adtcore:description: Creates a factory method create in class lcl. If the class contains attributes, a dialog is started and you can select those attributes which should be reflected as parameters of the factory method.

adtcore:objectReference.adtcore:name: Generate constructor
adtcore:objectReference.adtcore:description: Creates a constructor in class lcl. If the class contains attributes a dialog is started and you can select those attributes which should be reflected as parameters of constructor.

adtcore:objectReference.adtcore:name: Generate class constructor
adtcore:objectReference.adtcore:description: Creates an empty class constructor for class lcl.

adtcore:objectReference.adtcore:name: Delete 'lcl'
adtcore:objectReference.adtcore:description:
Deletes local class lcl.

The deletion will be executed even if usages of lcl exist.

adtcore:objectReference.adtcore:name: Generate table type for 'lcl'
adtcore:objectReference.adtcore:description:
Adds a new type definition to lcl.

TYPES: tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO lcl.
